raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "be born in"
  role subject "Carmen"
  role location "Zaragoza"
  role time "1938"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "be in"
  role subject "the family"
  role location "Teruel"
  role time "for some years"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty hedged

@s3 stated
  relation "marry"
  role subject "Carmen"
  role object "Joaquín"
  role location "Alicante"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "move to"
  role subject "Carmen"
  role destination "Valencia"
  role time "after the wedding"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  speaker "the user's mother"

@s5 stated
  relation "move to"
  role subject "Carmen"
  role destination "Valencia"
  role time "before the wedding"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  speaker "the user's uncle"

@q query
  select ?t1
  select ?t2
  order ?t1 before ?t2
  where all
    match
      relation "marry"
      role subject "Carmen"
      role object "Joaquín"
      role time ?t1
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "move to"
      role subject "Carmen"
      role destination "Valencia"
      role time ?t2
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
